title: Levoit Humidifier for Bedroom, 25dB Ultra Quiet, Top Fill
features: 𝐍𝐨 𝐃𝐢𝐬𝐭𝐮𝐫𝐛𝐚𝐧𝐜𝐞 𝐖𝐡𝐞𝐧 𝐒𝐥𝐞𝐞𝐩𝐢𝐧𝐠: The Classic 160 cool mist humidifier is designed for undisturbed sleep, operating at 25 dB-the optimal comfort level for human hearing -with full light-off; Helps create a peaceful and quiet atmosphere, the ideal humidifier for bedrooms and baby nurseries

𝐄𝐚𝐬𝐲 𝐓𝐨𝐩-𝐅𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐃𝐞𝐬𝐢𝐠𝐧: The upgraded top-filling design features a detachable tank with an 16 cm wider opening, eliminating the need to flip the tank or deal with water spill; Simply remove the cover in one step to fill the tank with ease
𝐄𝐚𝐬𝐲 𝐭𝐨 𝐔𝐬𝐞: Customize the mist output with just one knob and adjust the direction freely with the 360-degree nozzle; Enjoy full control of your air humidifier

𝐌𝐮𝐜𝐡 𝐄𝐚𝐬𝐢𝐞𝐫 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐂𝐥𝐞𝐚𝐧𝐢𝐧𝐠: Easily clean the inside of the tank through its big opening; The detachable designs and simple construction of the base leave no hard-to-reach corners when cleaning; A cleaning brush is included for effortless maintenance

𝐂𝐨𝐧𝐭𝐢𝐧𝐮𝐨𝐮𝐬 𝐇𝐮𝐦𝐢𝐝𝐢𝐟𝐢𝐜𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐀𝐥𝐥 𝐍𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭: With a 2.5-liter capacity, it runs up to 25 hours on low, ensuring full-night use without stagnant water leftover. Releases a cool mist at 190 ml/hr, reaching heights up to 70 cm, helps quickly relieve congestion and dry throat
